statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other underlying cardiac arrhythmias
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with rhythm disturbances and guide further management
The diagnosis codes R55, I48.91, and I49.9 are submitted in connection with this service
The claim was denied with reason code CO-22
The submitted records support the diagnosis codes R55, I48.91, and I49.9
